text: It is a decided folly to lose a friend for a jest; but, in my mind, it is not a much less degree of folly to make an enemy of an indifferent and neutral person, for the sake of a 'bon mot'.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter LXXI, to his son, London, May 22, Old Style 1749
